$$P(M=1 \mid Y=1) = P(M=1 \mid Y=1, Z=1)P(Z=1 \mid Y=1) + P(M=1 \mid Y=1, Z=0)P(Z=0 \mid Y=1)$$

Calculation:
$$P(M=1 \mid Y=1) = (0.57 \times 0.34) + (0.96 \times 0.66)$$
$$P(M=1 \mid Y=1) = 0.1938 + 0.6336 = 0.8274$$
